title: Lightly Roasted Syrian Oyster Mushrooms Skillet
description: A flavorful and healthy Syrian dish featuring roasted oyster mushrooms, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner and is whole30-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the oyster mushrooms with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and sumac until they are evenly coated.
Spread the mushrooms in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 15 minutes.
While the mushrooms are roasting, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Remove the mushrooms from the oven and add them to the skillet with the garlic.
Sprinkle the paprika over the mushrooms and stir to combine.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the mushrooms and stir to combine.
Cook the mushrooms for an additional 2 minutes, until they are lightly browned and crispy.
Serve the mushrooms hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
